The Title Heritage Bang Tao

Condominium in Bang Tao
HomeNew ProjectsThe Title Heritage Bang Tao

Project overview

Neo-classic condominium in Bang Tao blending Phuket heritage charm with luxury and relaxation. Construction was reported about 99% complete in October 2026; ready to move.

Facilities include a beach pool, sky pool, fitness, onsen and rooftop onsen.
